WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(l.derived_total_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), shares AS (SELECT product_color, invoiced, invoiced * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced) OVER () AS share, AVG(invoiced) OVER () AS avg_invoiced FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced - avg_invoiced) AS avg_excess_over_color_average FROM shares WHERE invoiced > avg_invoiced
alternatives: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(l.derived_product_cost) AS invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), shares AS (SELECT product_color, invoiced, invoiced * 1.0 / SUM(invoiced) OVER () AS share, AVG(invoiced) OVER () AS avg_invoiced FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(invoiced) AS avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(invoiced - avg_invoiced) AS avg_excess_over_color_average FROM shares WHERE invoiced > avg_invoiced

sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(l.product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS qty FROM Invoice_Line_Items l JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), stats AS (SELECT product_color, qty, 1.0 * qty / SUM(qty) OVER () AS share, AVG(1.0 * qty) OVER () AS avg_qty_all FROM color_totals) SELECT AVG(1.0 * qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(qty - avg_qty_all) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM stats WHERE qty > avg_qty_all;

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS combined_total, AVG(rt.total - o.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rt.total > o.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id
alternatives: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id), store_avg AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total) AS combined_total, AVG(rt.total - s.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals rt JOIN store_avg s ON s.store_id = rt.store_id WHERE rt.total > s.avg_total GROUP BY rt.store_id

sql: WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_paid) AS overall_avg FROM rental_totals) SELECT rt.store_id, SUM(rt.total_paid) AS total_payment_sum, AVG(rt.total_paid - o.overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM rental_totals rt CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rt.total_paid > o.overall_avg GROUP BY rt.store_id ORDER BY rt.store_id

WITH g AS (
 SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id,
 p.product_color AS product_color,
 AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity,
 AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
 FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
 JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
 JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
 GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color
), r AS (
 SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_ratio,
 RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY avg_quantity IS NULL, avg_quantity DESC) AS rnk
 FROM g
)
SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_ratio, rnk
FROM r
WHERE rnk <= 3

SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, qty_rank FROM (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY (avg_quantity IS NULL), avg_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank FROM (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color) g) r WHERE qty_rank <= 3

WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), c AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS g FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(r.n) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - c.g) AS avg_excess_over_cross_region_avg FROM r CROSS JOIN c WHERE r.avg_amt > c.g
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), c AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS g FROM trans) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS avg_transaction_amount, AVG(r.n) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - c.g) AS avg_excess_over_cross_region_avg FROM r CROSS JOIN c WHERE r.avg_amt > c.g

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_of_avg_amounts, AVG(r.cnt) AS mean_of_txn_counts, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mean_avg) AS mean_excess_over_cross_region_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mean_avg;

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_rate_per_day, avg_rate_per_day / AVG(avg_rate_per_day) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_ratings FROM r

WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM a) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.n * 1.0) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM a CROSS JOIN m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate

sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - o.mean_rate) AS avg_excess FROM album_rates a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.rate > o.mean_rate

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount AS average_budgeted_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS amount_above_mean_of_averages, p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean_of_averages FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg;

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amt FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS overall_avg FROM per_name), kept AS (SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amt, p.avg_amt - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amt > o.overall_avg) SELECT event_name, avg_amt AS average_budgeted_amount, diff_from_overall, avg_amt / (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) FROM kept) AS ratio_to_kept_average FROM kept

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, spend_ratio, spend_ratio / (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) FROM ev) AS relative_ratio FROM ev ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT BillingState, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt;

WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM inv) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM dev ORDER BY (deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country)) IS NULL, deviation_minus_country_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), cd AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS dev_minus_country FROM dev), r AS (SELECT cd.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN dev_minus_country IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, dev_minus_country DESC) AS rnk FROM cd) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, dev_minus_country FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY rnk, InvoiceId

WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT powerstatus, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, cnt, cnt * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT gender, order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT gender, order_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH st AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.equipstatus HAVING AVG(s.pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.avg_pulse, st.avg_pulse - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM st CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE st.avg_pulse > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.avg_pulse, k1.excess1, k1.avg_pulse - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k1.avg_pulse > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse_final, AVG(excess1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(excess2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2

WITH tel AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS tavg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), st AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(tavg) AS savg FROM tel WHERE tavg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.savg, st.savg - m1.mean1 AS ex1 FROM st CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE st.savg > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.savg, k1.ex1, k1.savg - m2.mean2 AS ex2 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k1.savg > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(savg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ex1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(ex2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2;

WITH acc AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_total, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, account_total, txn_count, 1.0 * account_total / SUM(account_total) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM acc ORDER BY (share IS NULL), share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS account_sum, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, txn_count, CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share FROM acct ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), a AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.match_count > a.avg_cnt

WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), k AS (SELECT timespan, avg_ratio, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(cnt) AS total_fee_records, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean_count FROM k WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS a FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId=r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(cs.wins) AS v FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId=cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId=r.circuitId), g AS (SELECT AVG(c.a) AS v FROM c, o WHERE c.a > o.v) SELECT AVG(c.a) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(c.a - o.v) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(c.a - g.v) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM c, o, g WHERE c.a > g.v

sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gain FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), ca AS (SELECT country, AVG(gain) AS avg_gain FROM s GROUP BY country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gain) AS m FROM ca), k AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_gain, ca.avg_gain - m1.m AS ex1 FROM ca, m1 WHERE ca.avg_gain > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gain) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.avg_gain, k.ex1, k.avg_gain - m2.m AS ex2 FROM k, m2 WHERE k.avg_gain > m2.m) SELECT AVG(avg_gain) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(ex1) AS mean_excess_over_all_mean, AVG(ex2) AS mean_excess_over_group_mean FROM f

WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), x AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS overall_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT City, SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt - city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / overall_total) AS avg_share_of_total FROM x WHERE cnt > city_avg GROUP BY City
alternatives: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), x AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer) AS overall_total FROM rep_counts) SELECT City, SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt - city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / overall_total) AS avg_share_of_total FROM x WHERE cnt > city_avg GROUP BY City

sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City AS City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_avg AS (SELECT City, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM rep_counts GROUP BY City), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM rep_counts) SELECT r.City, SUM(r.cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(r.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess, AVG(r.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt) AS avg_share FROM rep_counts r JOIN city_avg a ON a.City = r.City CROSS JOIN total t WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt GROUP BY r.City

WITH s AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, f.shortintrt, f.optvolrt, AVG(f.shortintrt) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS mix_avg_short FROM sentimentandfundamentals f JOIN transactionrecord t ON f.transref = t.transreg) SELECT transreg AS transaction_ref, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(shortintrt) / NULLIF(MAX(mix_avg_short), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM s GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH per AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(f.shortintrt) AS a, AVG(f.optvolrt) AS o FROM sentimentandfundamentals f JOIN transactionrecord t ON f.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT per.*, AVG(a) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_avg FROM per) SELECT transreg AS transaction_ref, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, a AS avg_short_interest, o AS avg_option_volume_ratio, a / NULLIF(mix_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM g ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql:
WITH per_txn AS (
  SELECT t.transreg AS transreg,
         t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist,
         AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short,
         AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
with_base AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, avg_short, avg_opt,
         AVG(avg_short) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS baseline
  FROM per_txn
)
SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference,
       ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       avg_short AS avg_short_interest,
       avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
       CASE WHEN baseline IS NULL OR baseline = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_short / baseline END AS short_interest_ratio
FROM with_base
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio IS NULL, short_interest_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total, SUM(t.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.av
alternatives: WITH t AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost),0) AS total, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS n FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total, SUM(t.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.av

sql: WITH line AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS n_expenses FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_of_above_avg_lines, SUM(l.n_expenses) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM line l CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_total

SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId ORDER BY (AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0)) IS NULL, ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM MediaType m LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY (AVG(t.UnitPrice) / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track), 0)) IS NULL, ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT MediaTypeId, avg_price, avg_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM per_type) AS ratio_to_baseline FROM per_type ORDER BY ratio_to_baseline DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, fielding_count * 1.0 / SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(fielding_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, share, fielding_count - avg_count AS above_average FROM s WHERE fielding_count > avg_count ORDER BY fielding_count DESC;
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, SUM(f.g) AS fielding_count FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, fielding_count * 1.0 / SUM(fielding_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(fielding_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT batting_hand, fielding_count, share, fielding_count - avg_count AS above_average FROM s WHERE fielding_count > avg_count ORDER BY fielding_count DESC;

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT bats, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT bats, cnt, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt;

SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0) OVER () AS count_relative_to_avg, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT city_id, address_count, (1.0 * address_count) / AVG(1.0 * address_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_per_city, (1.0 * address_count) / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS t ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC, city_id LIMIT 10

WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS g FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.n_scans * 1.0) AS avg_scans_per_operator, AVG(op.avg_rate) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_rate - overall.g) AS avg_excess_over_all FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_rate > overall.g
alternatives: WITH op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS n_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS g FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.n_scans * 1.0) AS avg_scans_per_operator, AVG(op.avg_rate) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_rate - overall.g) AS avg_excess_over_all FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_rate > overall.g

sql: WITH per_scan AS (SELECT crewref, gbsize / spanmin AS gbpm FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0), op AS (SELECT s.crewref, COUNT(*) AS scan_cnt, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gbpm FROM scans s WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gbpm) AS overall_avg FROM op) SELECT AVG(op.scan_cnt * 1.0) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(op.avg_gbpm) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(op.avg_gbpm - overall.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM op CROSS JOIN overall WHERE op.avg_gbpm > overall.overall_avg

WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share_of_total, cnt * 1.0 / AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM c

SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref) AS diff_from_overall_avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat

WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_ambictemp, avg_imgcount, avg_imgcount - AVG(avg_imgcount) OVER () AS imgcount_diff_from_mean_of_status_avgs FROM per_status

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS excess_over_average FROM rates WHERE rate > (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) ORDER BY rate DESC

sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.MediaTypeName, r.rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS diff_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate ORDER BY r.rate DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share_minus_avg > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share_minus_avg > 0 ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH proj AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS fund_avg FROM proj) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - fund_avg AS margin FROM m ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH proj AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS fund_avg FROM proj) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - fund_avg AS margin FROM m ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql:
WITH proj AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.boxx * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), withavg AS (
  SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio,
         AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS source_avg
  FROM proj
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - source_avg AS excess
FROM withavg
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t), hi AS (SELECT t.name, t.total, a.avg_total FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total) FROM hi) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM hi)) AS avg_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(total - avg_total) FROM hi) AS avg_excess_over_average_total
alternatives: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM t), hi AS (SELECT t.name, t.total, t.avg_laps, a.avg_total FROM t, a WHERE t.total > a.avg_total) SELECT SUM(total) AS combined_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_laps_completed, AVG(total - avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average_total FROM hi

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(t.avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps, AVG(t.total_points - a.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM t, a WHERE t.total_points > a.avg_total

WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), scored AS (SELECT zoneregistry, insurstat, ratio, mesh_count, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_above_avg_sites, COUNT(*) AS site_count, AVG(ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM scored WHERE ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat

WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT r.zoneregistry, r.insurstat, r.avg_ratio, a.status_avg_ratio FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.insurstat = r.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg_ratio) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_site_count, AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat

WITH pt AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS d1, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS d2 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(d1) AS a1, AVG(d2) AS a2 FROM pt GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(a2) AS mean_a2 FROM sx) SELECT AVG(sx.a1) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(sx.a2) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(sx.a2) - (SELECT mean_a2 FROM m) AS exceeds_mean_by FROM sx WHERE sx.a2 > (SELECT mean_a2 FROM m)

WITH pat AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_tp, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_pt FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(aptt_pt) AS aptt_pt FROM pat GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(aptt_pt) AS mean_ap FROM sx) SELECT AVG(sx.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(sx.aptt_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(sx.aptt_pt) - (SELECT mean_ap FROM m) AS exceed_mean FROM sx WHERE sx.aptt_pt > (SELECT mean_ap FROM m)

SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count, CAST(SUM(t.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) AS fraction FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH s AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT s.account_id, d.A3 AS region, s.total_amount, s.transaction_count, CAST(s.total_amount AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM s) AS fraction FROM s JOIN account a ON a.account_id = s.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, num_transactions, CAST(net_flow AS REAL) / SUM(net_flow) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM per_account ORDER BY share_of_total DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers cu LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY (share - avg_share) IS NULL, (share - avg_share) DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Customers cu JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY (share - avg_share) IS NULL, (share - avg_share) DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM Customers cu LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, 1.0 * num_orders / NULLIF(SUM(num_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures f CROSS JOIN t WHERE f.articount IS NOT NULL AND t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS articount FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), s AS (SELECT g.zoneref, g.articount, CAST(g.articount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM g CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref, s.articount, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH u AS (SELECT zoneref, articount FROM scanfeatures), t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM u), s AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.articount, CAST(u.articount AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM u CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.articount AS artifact_count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s.share - a.avg_share) IS NULL, (s.share - a.avg_share) DESC LIMIT 10

alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT k.constructorId, k.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors k LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = k.constructorId GROUP BY k.constructorId, k.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS standings_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) FROM counts) AS diff_from_avg FROM counts ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate) * 1.0 / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd
SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc, AVG(GOT) - (SELECT AVG(GOT) FROM Laboratory) AS got_diff FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID ORDER BY (got_diff IS NULL), got_diff DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT ID, avg_got, avg_rbc, avg_got - (SELECT AVG(avg_got) FROM p) AS got_diff FROM p ORDER BY (got_diff IS NULL), got_diff DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS overall FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.overall AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.overall) IS NULL, p.avg_got - o.overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH d AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client GROUP BY district_id), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM client) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(d.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(d.cnt * 1.0 / tot.n) AS avg_district_share FROM d JOIN district di ON di.district_id = d.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY di.A3

WITH dc AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client GROUP BY district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS t FROM dc) SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.t) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district d ON d.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY d.A3

WITH t AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS n FROM manager_award m JOIN player p ON p.player_id = m.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT throws, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT throws, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) FROM t) AS share_of_all_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(total_home_games) FROM t) AS ratio_to_average FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_home_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total_home_games) FROM t) AS share_of_all_home_games, total_home_games * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game) AS ratio_to_average FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(games) FROM home_game) AS fraction_of_total, SUM(games) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game) AS ratio_to_avg_record FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUM(games) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ratio_to_avg_record DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bm FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bm) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bm
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bm FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.bm) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bm

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench

WITH c AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_above_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT d.district_id, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM district d LEFT JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, CAST(account_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM c) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_above_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH d AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM d) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM s ORDER BY share_diff DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH acct AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diffs AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM acct) AS diff FROM acct), reg AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff, AVG(diff) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff, diff - region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM reg WHERE diff > region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diff AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM c), r AS (SELECT *, AVG(diff_from_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff FROM diff) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff_from_avg, diff_from_avg - region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM r WHERE diff_from_avg > region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS ar, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS ao FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS o FROM ev) SELECT status, AVG(ar) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ao) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ar) / (SELECT o FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY status
alternatives: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS ar, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS ao FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(b.remaining) AS o FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event) SELECT status, AVG(ar) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ao) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ar) / (SELECT o FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY status

sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), st AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_overspend) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM ev GROUP BY status) SELECT status, avg_remaining, avg_overspend_rate, avg_remaining / AVG(avg_remaining) OVER () AS remaining_ratio FROM st

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS event_rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t;

WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total, AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM per_type), shares AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.n, p.n * 1.0 / tot.total AS share, tot.avg_n FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN tot) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(n - avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares WHERE n > avg_n

WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM stats WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_signed_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions e INNER JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase
alternatives: SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM orderexecutions e INNER JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase

sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase

WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(ANA) IS NOT NULL), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - m.mean_avg AS gap_above_mean FROM per_id p CROSS JOIN m WHERE p.avg_ana > m.mean_avg ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.ID, g.avg_ana, g.avg_ana - m.overall AS excess FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_ana > m.overall ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total, COUNT(*) AS k FROM c) SELECT c.ID, c.n AS num_examinations, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.n * 1.0 / t.total - 1.0 / t.k AS margin_above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.n * 1.0 / t.total > 1.0 / t.k ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), f AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS frac FROM g), a AS (SELECT ID, cnt, frac, AVG(frac) OVER () AS avg_frac FROM f) SELECT ID, cnt AS num_examinations, frac AS fraction, frac - avg_frac AS excess_over_average FROM a WHERE frac > avg_frac ORDER BY excess_over_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mktnote, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS avg_net FROM j), pairs AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net) AS pair_avg FROM j GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.pair_avg) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.pair_avg - ov.avg_net) AS mean_excess_over_overall FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE p.pair_avg > ov.avg_net;

WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS pair, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), pair_avg AS (SELECT pair, AVG(net) AS avg_net FROM matched GROUP BY pair), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS b FROM pair_avg), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_net, p.avg_net - b.b AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE p.avg_net > b.b) SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM kept

WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderbase IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS a FROM j), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS ca FROM j GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(ch.ca) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate, AVG(ch.ca - overall.a) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM ch CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ch.ca > overall.a
alternatives: WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND o.orderbase IS NOT NULL), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS ca FROM j GROUP BY orderbase), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ca) AS a FROM ch) SELECT AVG(ch.ca) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate, AVG(ch.ca - overall.a) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM ch CROSS JOIN overall WHERE ch.ca > overall.a

sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS b FROM linked), ch AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM linked WHERE orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rate, AVG(ch.avg_rate - bench.b) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM ch CROSS JOIN bench WHERE ch.avg_rate > bench.b

SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) AS fraction_of_region, COUNT(c.client_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(c.client_id)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM district d LEFT JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC, d.district_id LIMIT 10

WITH d AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, di.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM disp dp JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, di.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share_of_region, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM d ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, district_id LIMIT 10

WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s AS (SELECT rating, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT rating, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS n FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s AS (SELECT rating, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT rating, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

sql: WITH rc AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), sh AS (SELECT rating, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM rc), kept AS (SELECT rating, cnt, share FROM sh WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM sh)) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM sh)) AS avg_excess FROM kept

WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.av) AS avg_above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.av
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.av) AS avg_above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.av

sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_all FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, a.avg_all FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.cnt > a.avg_all) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(cnt - avg_all) AS avg_excess FROM k

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS m FROM Laboratory), ab AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a FROM p, o WHERE p.a > o.m) SELECT ID, a AS avg_hgb, a - (SELECT m FROM o) AS above_overall_avg, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM ab) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM ab ORDER BY diff_from_above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM p), ab AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a FROM p, o WHERE p.a > o.m) SELECT ID, a AS avg_hgb, a - (SELECT m FROM o) AS above_overall_avg, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM ab) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM ab ORDER BY diff_from_above_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.o AS above_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.o) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH matched AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count * 1.0 / AVG(order_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_per_scope FROM matched
alternatives: WITH matched AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share_of_total, order_count * 1.0 / AVG(order_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_per_scope FROM matched

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, n AS risk_margin_record_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM c

WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM oc), above AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.cnt > avg_all.a), avg_above AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS b FROM above) SELECT above.account_id, above.cnt AS order_count, above.cnt - avg_all.a AS diff_above_overall_avg, above.cnt - avg_above.b AS diff_above_avg_of_above FROM above, avg_all, avg_above ORDER BY diff_above_avg_of_above DESC LIMIT 10

WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order" o WHERE o.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account)) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS a), kept AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.cnt FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account) AND oc.cnt > avg_all.a), avg_kept AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS k FROM kept) SELECT kept.account_id, kept.cnt AS order_count, kept.cnt - avg_all.a AS diff_above_overall_avg, kept.cnt - avg_kept.k AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept, avg_all, avg_kept ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT archstat, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT archstat, tally, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_amount, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), sh AS (SELECT link_to_member, s, CAST(s AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.s) AS total_amount, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(sh.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh CROSS JOIN a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share

WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_of_signed_avgs, AVG(f.avg_bal) AS avg_of_balance_avgs, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_rem FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS overall_avg FROM orderexecutions), above AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_rem, p.avg_rem - o.overall_avg AS excess_overall FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_rem > o.overall_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS grp_avg FROM above), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_rem, a.excess_overall, a.avg_rem - g.grp_avg AS excess_group FROM above a CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE a.avg_rem > g.grp_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS avg_of_order_avgs, AVG(excess_overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall, AVG(excess_group) AS avg_excess_over_group FROM kept
