WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT c.SEX, c.n AS test_records, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.n - t.avg_n AS above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.n > t.avg_n ORDER BY c.n DESC
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT c.SEX, c.n AS test_records, c.n * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.n - t.avg_n AS above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.n > t.avg_n ORDER BY c.n DESC

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, cnt AS test_records, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM g) AS above_average FROM g WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM g)

SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share_of_total FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, observstation LIMIT 10
SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.av
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_count, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.av

sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.cnt - c.a) AS avg_excess FROM side_counts s CROSS JOIN avg_c c WHERE s.cnt > c.a

WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acct_avg) AS region_figure FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg, r.region_figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_figure > o.overall_avg ORDER BY r.region_figure DESC

WITH acct AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
),
reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS figure
  FROM acct
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg
)
SELECT reg.region,
       reg.figure,
       reg.figure - overall.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg,
       reg.figure / overall.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg
FROM reg CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE reg.figure > overall.overall_avg
ORDER BY reg.figure DESC;

SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS conserved_sites, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat
alternatives: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS conserved_sites, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurstat, site_count, site_count * 1.0 / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM g

WITH t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.bats IS NULL OR TRIM(p.bats) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.bats END AS bats, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT bats, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT bats, tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT bats, tally, share, share - avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(p.bats),'') AS bats, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(TRIM(p.bats),'')), s AS (SELECT bats, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT bats, award_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS avg_fraction_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(c.cnt - s.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt

WITH c AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS n FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS n FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT order_id, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH acc AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, t.account_id,
         AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amt,
         AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3, t.account_id
),
reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_balance
  FROM acc
  GROUP BY region
),
r2 AS (
  SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance,
         AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS mean_amount
  FROM reg
)
SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, avg_amount / mean_amount AS amount_ratio
FROM r2
WHERE mean_amount IS NOT NULL;

WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg_amount, AVG(avg_bal) AS avg_balance FROM acc GROUP BY region), fin AS (SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM reg) SELECT region, avg_amount, avg_balance, avg_amount / overall_mean AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM fin WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL

WITH pp AS (SELECT b.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason b JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id GROUP BY b.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles * 1.0 / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM pp), g AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap FROM g ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

WITH pa AS (
  SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(b.double) AS avg_doubles
  FROM batting_postseason b
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
  WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.bats) <> ''
  GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
idx AS (
  SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles,
         avg_doubles * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM pa) AS idx
  FROM pa
),
final AS (
  SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx,
         idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS idx_minus_hand_avg
  FROM idx
)
SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx AS index_value, idx_minus_hand_avg
FROM final
ORDER BY (idx_minus_hand_avg IS NULL), idx_minus_hand_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_account AS (
  SELECT a.account_id AS account_number, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
)
SELECT account_number, frequency, avg_amount,
       avg_amount / AVG(avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS ratio
FROM per_account
ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC, account_number
LIMIT 10;

WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), with_freq AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, AVG(avg_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS freq_avg FROM per_account) SELECT account_id, frequency, avg_amount, CASE WHEN freq_avg = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_amount * 1.0 / freq_avg END AS ratio FROM with_freq ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_rel_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.aream2 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL THEN s.volm3 END), 0) AS area_vol_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), with_avg AS (SELECT *, AVG(area_vol_ratio) OVER () AS avg_ratio FROM per_source) SELECT fundflux, avg_rel_diff, area_vol_ratio, area_vol_ratio - avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM with_avg WHERE area_vol_ratio > avg_ratio
alternatives: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_rel_diff, AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS area_vol_ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), with_avg AS (SELECT *, AVG(area_vol_ratio) OVER () AS avg_ratio FROM per_source) SELECT fundflux, avg_rel_diff, area_vol_ratio, area_vol_ratio - avg_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM with_avg WHERE area_vol_ratio > avg_ratio

sql: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, SUM(s.aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume) AS avg_atv FROM per_source) SELECT ps.funding_source, ps.avg_y_vs_x_diff, ps.area_to_volume, ps.area_to_volume - o.avg_atv AS above_average_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.area_to_volume > o.avg_atv
SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status
alternatives: SELECT status, cnt AS attendee_count, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM (SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status)

sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS proportion FROM per_status

WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), t AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS overall_avg FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM o CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg) IS NULL, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), t AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM o) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM o CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg) IS NULL, o.avg_qty - t.overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS baseline FROM Order_Items) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM o CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (o.avg_qty - b.baseline IS NULL), o.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC, o.order_id LIMIT 10

WITH station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, SUM(n_tel) AS telescope_count, SUM(n_tel) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(n_tel)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station GROUP BY lunarstage
alternatives: WITH station AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM station GROUP BY lunarstage

sql: WITH st AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH oc AS (SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o GROUP BY o.account_id) SELECT oc.account_id, d.A3 AS region, oc.order_count, oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) FROM oc) AS diff_from_avg FROM oc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC, oc.account_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diffed AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) FROM per_account) AS diff FROM per_account), ranked AS (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rnk FROM diffed) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM diffed ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10)) OR diff >= (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM diffed ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10)) ORDER BY diff DESC

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS overall FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL), c1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a FROM r, o WHERE r.a > o.overall), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_all FROM r), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_c1 FROM c1), c2 AS (SELECT c1.rating, c1.a FROM c1, m WHERE c1.a > m.mean_all) SELECT AVG(c2.a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(c2.a - o.overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(c2.a - m1.mean_c1) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean FROM c2, o, m1
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_all FROM r), c1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a FROM r, m WHERE r.a > m.mean_all), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_c1 FROM c1), c2 AS (SELECT c1.rating, c1.a FROM c1, m1 WHERE c1.a > m1.mean_c1) SELECT AVG(c2.a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(c2.a - m.mean_all) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(c2.a - m1.mean_c1) AS avg_above_first_cut_mean FROM c2, m, m1

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len FROM film GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS base FROM film), s1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.avg_len FROM r, b WHERE r.avg_len > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_len) AS m1 FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_len FROM s1, m WHERE s1.avg_len > m.m1) SELECT AVG(s2.avg_len) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(s2.avg_len - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(s2.avg_len - m.m1) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM s2, b, m

WITH per_mgr AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM per_mgr ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10;

SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM (SELECT ma.player_id AS player_id, p.death_country AS death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) t ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10;

WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town_city), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town) SELECT t.town_city, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average FROM town t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio ORDER BY ratio_above_average DESC

WITH item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item_town GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town)

WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, SUM(t.Bytes)*1.0/SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(r.n*1.0) AS avg_tracks, AVG(r.rate - o.a) AS avg_margin FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE r.rate > o.a
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.Bytes*1.0/t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(r.n*1.0) AS avg_tracks, AVG(r.rate - o.a) AS avg_margin FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE r.rate > o.a

sql: WITH mt AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM mt) SELECT AVG(mt.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(mt.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(mt.rate - avg_all.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM mt CROSS JOIN avg_all WHERE mt.rate > avg_all.avg_rate

WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, cnt AS employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a, SUM(n) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.n AS trader_type_count, c.n * 1.0 / s.tot AS share_of_total, c.n - s.a AS diff_from_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.a IS NOT NULL AND c.n > s.a
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.tradereg) AS n FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a, SUM(n) AS tot FROM c) SELECT c.tradekind AS trader_type, c.n AS trader_type_count, c.n * 1.0 / s.tot AS share_of_total, c.n - s.a AS diff_from_average FROM c CROSS JOIN s WHERE s.a IS NOT NULL AND c.n > s.a

sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT r.trdref) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind, p.cnt AS trader_count, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_average FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > s.avg_cnt

SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC, c.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10

WITH grp AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat), frac AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, n AS conservation_records, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction FROM grp), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS rnk FROM frac) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_records, fraction FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, zoneref, insurstat;

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), o AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE r.per_day > o.overall

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS pd FROM film GROUP BY rating), g AS (SELECT AVG(pd) AS gavg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.pd) AS avg_per_day, AVG(r.pd - g.gavg) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN g WHERE r.pd > g.gavg

WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.av
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.n - a.av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.av

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above_average_types, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

WITH grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, above_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q
alternatives: WITH grp AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM grp), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, g.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE g.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, above_overall AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q

sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') AS rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - baseline AS diff_above_baseline, avg_mod - AVG(avg_mod) OVER () AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept

WITH per_order AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), scored AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS above_tif_avg, fill_rank FROM scored WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND fill_rank <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank, ordersmark
alternatives: WITH j AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM j GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), tif AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS tif_avg FROM j GROUP BY timespan), scored AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.timespan, p.avg_fill, t.tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.timespan ORDER BY p.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS fill_rank FROM per_order p JOIN tif t ON t.timespan IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.timespan) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS above_tif_avg, fill_rank FROM scored WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND fill_rank <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank, ordersmark

sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT e.ordersmark AS ordersmark, o.timespan AS timespan, AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY e.ordersmark, o.timespan), with_tif AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS tif_avg, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS excess_over_tif_avg, rnk AS rank_in_timespan FROM with_tif WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark

WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT hand, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;
alternatives: WITH t AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT a.player_id) AS n FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT hand, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS sh FROM c), t AS (SELECT hand, cnt, sh, AVG(sh) OVER () AS avg_sh FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - avg_sh) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE sh > avg_sh

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM g) AS share_of_total, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(member_count) FROM g) AS ratio_to_avg FROM g ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM g) AS share_of_total, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(member_count) FROM g) AS ratio_to_avg FROM g ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(*) / AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH s AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM s) AS ana_ratio FROM s

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS ana FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), per_sex AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(igg) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(ana) AS avg_ana FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(race_count) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c) SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, c.race_count / t.total AS share, c.race_count / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS margin_above_avg_share FROM c, t ORDER BY margin_above_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s), f AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY excess_over_avg DESC) AS rk FROM f) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess_over_avg FROM r WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY excess_over_avg DESC

WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS w FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(w) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg GROUP BY country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS a FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.a), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS g FROM above) SELECT ab.country, ab.avg_wins, ab.avg_wins - o.a AS above_overall_avg, ab.avg_wins - g.g AS above_group_avg FROM above ab, overall o, grp g WHERE ab.avg_wins > g.g ORDER BY ab.avg_wins DESC

WITH race_avg AS (SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country), country_avg AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins FROM race_avg WHERE race_wins IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS b FROM country_avg), kept AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, bench WHERE ca.avg_wins > bench.b), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM kept) SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins AS average, k.avg_wins - bench.b AS above_overall_benchmark, k.avg_wins - kept_mean.m AS above_second_mean FROM kept k, bench, kept_mean WHERE k.avg_wins > kept_mean.m

WITH joined AS (SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), stats AS (SELECT *, AVG(instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg, AVG(instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS group_avg FROM joined) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / NULLIF(group_avg, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_group_avg, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM stats WHERE instownpct > overall_avg;

WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS own FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT mix, AVG(own) AS mix_avg FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(own) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.own, b.mix_avg, o.overall_avg FROM units u JOIN base b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE u.own > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_kept_ownership, AVG(own / mix_avg) AS avg_ownership_to_baseline_ratio, AVG(own - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM kept

WITH combo AS (SELECT o.recordvault AS order_ref, o.orderflow AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), shares AS (SELECT order_ref, status, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS share FROM combo), gaps AS (SELECT order_ref, status, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT order_ref, status, record_count, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_avg FROM gaps ORDER BY gap_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), s AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, record_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_status_avg FROM d WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_minus_status_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH dept AS (SELECT mj.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major mj ON mj.major_id = m.link_to_major GROUP BY mj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM dept), avg_s AS (SELECT department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - avg_share AS diff_from_avg_share FROM avg_s WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC;

WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT mj.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM dept_counts) AS share FROM dept_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC

WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.n * 1.0) AS average_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS average_excess_over_overall_average FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.n * 1.0) AS avg_invoiced_orders, AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n;

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, ratio, film_count, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_ratio FROM r

WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM c ORDER BY qc_count DESC

SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux

WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall, p.avg_mod / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel), above AS (SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod, o.overall_avg FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg) SELECT telescref, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, avg_mod / (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM above) AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above ORDER BY ratio_to_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM j GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS o FROM j), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_opt, ABS(p.avg_opt - o.o) AS dev FROM pairs p JOIN overall o ON o.o IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_opt IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, dev, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS td FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(dev - td) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE dev > td GROUP BY tradekind
alternatives: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM j GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_opt) AS o FROM pairs), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_opt, ABS(p.avg_opt - o.o) AS dev FROM pairs p JOIN overall o ON o.o IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_opt IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, dev, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS td FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(dev - td) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE dev > td GROUP BY tradekind

sql: WITH combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ovr FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ovr) AS baseline FROM combo), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_ovr, c.avg_ovr - b.baseline AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ovr, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ovr) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind

WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval, sc.scancount, sc.gbsize, sc.spanmin FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref), g AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM s GROUP BY healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scans, g.gb_per_min, g.gb_per_min - a.avg_gb_per_min AS excess_over_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min > a.avg_gb_per_min
alternatives: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval, sc.scancount, sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) AS r FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref), g AS (SELECT healtheval, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(r) AS gb_per_min FROM s GROUP BY healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scans, g.gb_per_min, g.gb_per_min - a.avg_gb_per_min AS excess_over_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min > a.avg_gb_per_min

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scancount, g.gb_per_min, g.gb_per_min - a.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min > a.avg_rate

WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH copies AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM copies ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS vol FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, vol, vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM p) AS share FROM p), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.vol) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
alternatives: WITH p AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS vol FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, vol, vol / (SELECT SUM(vol) FROM p) AS share FROM p), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.vol) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt AS behaviour_count, s.share, s.share - av.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > av.avg_share

WITH j AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM j GROUP BY tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), f AS (SELECT tradekind, txn_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, txn_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM f WHERE share > avg_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS overall_net FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - o.overall_net) AS mean_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_net > o.overall_net
alternatives: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS overall_net FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - o.overall_net) AS mean_excess FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_net > o.overall_net

sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS b FROM fees) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b
SELECT staff_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, SUM(amount) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment WHERE rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY staff_id
SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id

WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, cnt AS qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref LIMIT 10

WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), grp AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_mod FROM linked) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall_mod) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall_mod GROUP BY g.weathprofile
alternatives: WITH linked AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), grp AS (SELECT telescregistry, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_mod FROM grp) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - ov.overall_mod) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM grp g CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE g.avg_mod > ov.overall_mod GROUP BY g.weathprofile

sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT t.telescregistry AS telescope, o.weathprofile AS weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM grp), kept AS (SELECT g.weathprofile, g.avg_mod, g.avg_phase, g.avg_mod - b.baseline AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_mod) AS avg_modulation_index, AVG(avg_phase) AS avg_phase_shift, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM kept GROUP BY weathprofile;

WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(l.CPK * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS a FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX), s1 AS (SELECT SEX, a, (SELECT AVG(a) FROM r) AS m1 FROM r), k1 AS (SELECT * FROM s1 WHERE a > m1), k2 AS (SELECT *, (SELECT AVG(a) FROM k1) AS m2 FROM k1), k3 AS (SELECT * FROM k2 WHERE a > m2) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_ratio, AVG(a - m1) AS avg_above_first_mean, AVG(a - m2) AS avg_above_second_mean FROM k3

WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, l.CPK * 1.0 / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''), g AS (SELECT sex, AVG(ratio) AS a FROM r WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sex), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g), k1 AS (SELECT g.sex, g.a FROM g, m1 WHERE g.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.sex, k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(k2.a - m1.m) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k2.a - m2.m) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2, m1, m2

WITH dc AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM dc), ab AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS above_region_avg FROM ra WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, above_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_above FROM ab ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_above DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, AVG(account_count * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM dc), ab AS (SELECT * FROM ra WHERE account_count > region_avg), r AS (SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS excess_over_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM ab), k AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_avg DESC) AS rk FROM r) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess_over_region_avg, ratio_to_overall_avg FROM k WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_avg DESC

WITH per_scope AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS fee_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS deviation_from_mean_of_scope_averages FROM per_scope
alternatives: WITH per_scope AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - COALESCE(f.rebrate, 0)) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate) AS fee_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_fee_rate, fee_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS deviation_from_mean_of_scope_averages FROM per_scope

sql: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT u.acctscope, o.recordvault, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope, o.recordvault), scope_stats AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_rates WHERE net_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, order_count, avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_of_scope_avgs FROM scope_stats

WITH buckets AS (SELECT o.timespan AS tif, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT tif, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_s FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_s) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM kept

WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, n, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_share_above_overall_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT st, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), with_avg AS (SELECT st, total, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total) AS combined_total, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT state, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), with_avg AS (SELECT state, total, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(total) AS combined_total, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_above_avg_states, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - m.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.overall
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate) * 1.0 / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - m.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.overall

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), g AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(avg_daily) OVER () AS overall_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall_daily) AS avg_excess FROM g WHERE avg_daily > overall_daily;

WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM s), av AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM av WHERE share > avg_share;
alternatives: WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(a.account_id) AS cnt FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM s), av AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM av WHERE share > avg_share;

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_id) AS cnt FROM Customers cu JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM t WHERE share > avg_share

WITH t AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally) OVER () AS avg_tally FROM t) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(tally - avg_tally) AS avg_excess_over_avg_tally FROM s WHERE tally > avg_tally;
alternatives: WITH t AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT birth_country, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally) OVER () AS avg_tally FROM t) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(tally - avg_tally) AS avg_excess_over_avg_tally FROM s WHERE tally > avg_tally;

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), t AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_records, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id LIMIT 10;
SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), c AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM j GROUP BY transreg, tradekind) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM c GROUP BY tradekind

WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY t.transreg, tr.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS avg_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind

WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS m FROM p) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(p.avg_diff / o.m) AS avg_ratio FROM p CROSS JOIN o GROUP BY p.SEX
alternatives: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS m FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(p.avg_diff / o.m) AS avg_ratio FROM p CROSS JOIN o GROUP BY p.SEX

sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall FROM p) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(p.avg_diff / o.overall) AS avg_ratio FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) FROM qualifying) AS ratio_to_average FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) FROM qualifying) AS ratio_to_average FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying WHERE driverId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY driverId) SELECT driverId, cnt AS qualifying_count, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS ratio FROM c ORDER BY ratio DESC, driverId ASC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT c.*, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT source, cnt AS count, cnt * 1.0 / total AS share_of_total, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average_by FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT c.*, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT source, cnt AS count, cnt * 1.0 / total AS share_of_total, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average_by FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT fundflux, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(project_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT fundflux, project_count, share, project_count - avg_count AS excess_over_avg FROM m WHERE project_count > avg_count

WITH acc AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM acc) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM acc a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH acc AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM trans) SELECT a.account_id, a.avg_amount, a.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM acc a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM per_account p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_total FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college
alternatives: SELECT m.college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_income, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / SUM(SUM(i.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college

sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT m.college AS college, i.amount AS amount FROM income i JOIN member mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major) SELECT college, SUM(amount) AS total_income, SUM(amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM linked) AS fraction_of_total FROM linked GROUP BY college

WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM k

WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.relative_gap, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg ORDER BY (p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff_above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.relative_gap, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg ORDER BY (p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, diff_above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (CAST(SUM(derived_product_cost) AS REAL) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_quantity, inv.cost_ratio, inv.avg_quantity - overall.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_quantity > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH d AS (SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member me ON i.link_to_member = me.member_id JOIN major m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), s AS (SELECT department, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM d), a AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH d AS (SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member mem ON mem.member_id = i.link_to_member JOIN major m ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major GROUP BY m.department), s AS (SELECT department, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM d) AS share FROM d), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_diff FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS bench1 FROM per_order), first_pass AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b1.bench1 AS margin1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE p.avg_fill > b1.bench1), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS bench2 FROM first_pass), final AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.margin1, f.avg_fill - b2.bench2 AS margin2 FROM first_pass f CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE f.avg_fill > b2.bench2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM final
alternatives: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(fillcount) AS bench1 FROM orderexecutions), first_pass AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b1.bench1 AS margin1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE p.avg_fill > b1.bench1), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS bench2 FROM first_pass), final AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.margin1, f.avg_fill - b2.bench2 AS margin2 FROM first_pass f CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE f.avg_fill > b2.bench2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM final

sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per), k1 AS (SELECT per.a AS a, per.a - b1.m AS e1 FROM per CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE per.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a AS a, k1.e1 AS e1, k1.a - b2.m AS e2 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM k2

WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_total, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_total, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share_of_total FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY copies DESC, film_id LIMIT 10

WITH film_copies AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), ranked AS (SELECT film_id, copies, copies * 1.0 / SUM(copies) OVER () AS share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copies DESC) AS rnk FROM film_copies), cutoff AS (SELECT copies AS cutoff_copies FROM (SELECT copies, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY copies DESC, film_id) AS rn FROM film_copies) t WHERE rn = 10) SELECT r.film_id, r.copies, r.share FROM ranked r, cutoff c WHERE r.copies >= c.cutoff_copies ORDER BY r.share DESC, r.film_id

WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count * 1.0 / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT time_in_force, risk_margin_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY time_in_force

WITH per_tif AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT time_in_force, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_tif) SELECT time_in_force, order_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM shares ORDER BY time_in_force

WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), s AS (SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS cnt FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), s AS (SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_cnt, CAST(order_cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS share FROM per_account), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_cnt) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_s) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s
