WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Order_Items), per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_cnt, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT n FROM total) AS item_share FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code), per_type AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(pp.avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(pp.item_cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(pp.item_share) AS avg_share FROM per_product pp JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pp.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(avg_cnt) AS avg_of_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS avg_of_order_item_share FROM per_type;
alternatives: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Order_Items), per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_cnt, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT n FROM total) AS item_share FROM Products p JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code), per_type AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(pp.avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(pp.item_cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(pp.item_share) AS avg_share FROM per_product pp JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pp.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(avg_cnt) AS avg_of_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS avg_of_order_item_share FROM per_type;

sql: WITH p AS (SELECT pr.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS q, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS c FROM Products pr JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = pr.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_id, pc.product_type_description), s AS (SELECT d, q, c, c * 1.0 / SUM(c) OVER () AS sh FROM p), t AS (SELECT d, AVG(q) AS aq, AVG(c) AS ac, AVG(sh) AS ash FROM s GROUP BY d) SELECT AVG(aq) AS avg_quantity, AVG(ac) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(ash) AS avg_share FROM t

WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), avgr AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avgr.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN avgr WHERE avgr.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avgr.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), avgr AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avgr.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN avgr WHERE avgr.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avgr.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN inv.cost_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff_from_overall FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY (AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget)) IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH e AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM e) AS diff_from_overall FROM e ORDER BY diff_from_overall IS NULL, diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT link_to_event, avg_spent, avg_remaining, avg_remaining - (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM per_event) AS diff_from_mean_avg_remaining FROM per_event ORDER BY diff_from_mean_avg_remaining DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_avg AS remaining_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_avg AS remaining_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_of_avgs FROM g) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_gb, avg_abs_cpu_gpu_diff, avg_remaining_gb / mean_of_avgs AS remaining_ratio FROM m WHERE mean_of_avgs IS NOT NULL ORDER BY remaining_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH e AS (SELECT ev.event_id, ev.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM event ev LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id GROUP BY ev.event_id, ev.location), r AS (SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY (avg_ratio IS NULL), avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk FROM e) SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk AS rank FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id;

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e.location) <> '' GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_ratio DESC) AS rnk FROM ev) SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY location, rnk, event_id;

WITH per_coin AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS b FROM per_coin), sel AS (SELECT p.avg_reb, p.avg_gap, p.avg_reb - bench.b AS excess FROM per_coin p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_reb > bench.b) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS mean_avg_rebate, AVG(avg_gap) AS mean_avg_relative_gap, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM sel

WITH per_coin AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS b FROM per_coin), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_reb, p.avg_gap, p.avg_reb - bench.b AS excess FROM per_coin p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_reb > bench.b) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebate_total, AVG(avg_gap) AS avg_of_avg_relative_gap, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM kept

WITH l AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS left_over FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_left_over, s.avg_left_over - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM (SELECT event_status, AVG(left_over) AS avg_left_over FROM l GROUP BY event_status) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(left_over) AS overall_avg FROM l) o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH s AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS avg_diff FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS baseline FROM s) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_diff AS average_amount_minus_spent, s.avg_diff - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM s CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL

WITH per_tx AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per_tx), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per_tx p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka), r2 AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM ranked) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, diff_from_overall_avg, diff_from_kept_avg FROM r2 WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST

WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_count * 1.0 / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM s) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share_above_average FROM t WHERE share_above_average > 0 ORDER BY share DESC
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count FROM circuits ci LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = ci.circuitId LEFT JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, qualifying_count * 1.0 / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_above_average FROM s) SELECT city, qualifying_count, share, share_above_average FROM t WHERE share_above_average > 0 ORDER BY share DESC

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT location, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT location, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT location, cnt AS qualifying_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM t WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB) AS alb, AVG(L.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(L.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM s) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - m.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.avg_alb > m.mean_alb

WITH patient_level AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_level GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM sex_level) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb AS avg_ALB, s.avg_ratio AS avg_UN_TBIL_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_level s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_alb

WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(g.n) AS total_count, AVG(g.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(t.bandusagepct) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(g.n) AS total_count, AVG(g.avg_bw - m.mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_bw, g.n, m.mean_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(avg_bw - mean_avg) AS avg_excess FROM k

WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS wins_diff_from_country_avg FROM c ORDER BY country;

WITH race_avg AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS p, AVG(wins) AS w FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.p) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.w) AS avg_wins FROM circuits c LEFT JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId LEFT JOIN race_avg ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_avg) AS avg_wins_minus_mean FROM country_avg

WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM counts), acct AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, cu.town_city FROM counts c JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL), town AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(cnt) AS town_cnt FROM acct GROUP BY town_city) SELECT acct.account_id, acct.town_city, acct.cnt AS num_transactions, acct.cnt * 1.0 / town.town_cnt AS share_of_town_transactions, acct.cnt / avgc.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM acct JOIN town ON town.town_city = acct.town_city CROSS JOIN avgc ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Financial_Transactions GROUP BY account_id), avgc AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Financial_Transactions) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Accounts) AS avg_cnt), acct AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, cu.town_city FROM counts c JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE cu.town_city IS NOT NULL), town AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(cnt) AS town_cnt FROM acct GROUP BY town_city) SELECT acct.account_id, acct.town_city, acct.cnt AS num_transactions, acct.cnt * 1.0 / town.town_cnt AS share_of_town_transactions, acct.cnt / avgc.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM acct JOIN town ON town.town_city = acct.town_city CROSS JOIN avgc ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM Accounts a JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.town_city) <> '' GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city) SELECT account_id, town, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS share_of_town_transactions, txn_count * 1.0 / AVG(txn_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM acct ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC, account_id LIMIT 10;

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), with_mean AS (SELECT ID, SEX, avg_wbc, ratio, AVG(ratio) OVER () AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT ID, SEX, avg_wbc, ratio, ratio - mean_ratio AS gap FROM with_mean WHERE ratio > mean_ratio ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB / l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(l.HGB / l.HCT) AS mean_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS gap FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB * 1.0 / l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH mc AS (SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member me JOIN major m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department), sh AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM mc) AS share FROM mc), da AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg_share FROM sh) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - dept_avg_share AS diff_above_dept_avg FROM da WHERE share > dept_avg_share ORDER BY diff_above_dept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH counts AS (SELECT ma.major_id, ma.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.major_id, ma.department), shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), dept AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg FROM shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - dept_avg AS diff_above_avg FROM dept WHERE share > dept_avg ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(st.station_avg) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.station_avg - g.overall_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM st CROSS JOIN g WHERE st.station_avg > g.overall_avg;
alternatives: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg FROM st) SELECT AVG(st.station_avg) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(st.station_avg - g.overall_avg) AS mean_above_average FROM st CROSS JOIN g WHERE st.station_avg > g.overall_avg;

sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS b FROM telescopes) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_of_station_averages, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.b) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.b

WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS second_avg FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_pulse FROM k1 k CROSS JOIN second s WHERE k.avg_pulse > s.second_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(f.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(f.avg_pulse - s.second_avg) AS mean_excess_over_second FROM fin f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN second s
alternatives: WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS overall_avg FROM tel), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_pulse > o.overall_avg), second AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS second_avg FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_pulse FROM k1 k CROSS JOIN second s WHERE k.avg_pulse > s.second_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(f.avg_pulse - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(f.avg_pulse - s.second_avg) AS mean_excess_over_second FROM fin f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN second s

sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM t), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a FROM t, b1 WHERE t.a > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), f AS (SELECT k1.a, b1.v AS v1, b2.v AS v2 FROM k1, b1, b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.v) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(a - v1) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(a - v2) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM f

SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) AS share FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance) > 0 ORDER BY share DESC, event_id LIMIT 10

SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, exec_count * 1.0 / SUM(exec_count) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s AS (SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, execution_count * 1.0 / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, execution_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS spent FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, spent, spent * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(spent) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH t AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.total) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_diff FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH per_site AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM per_site), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, s.feature_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH f AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, traitcount * 1.0 / SUM(traitcount) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM f) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM g WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), diffs AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_diff FROM (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_diff DESC) AS rnk FROM diffs d) t WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share_diff DESC, observstation

WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr GROUP BY cr.raceId), avg_e AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS avg_entries FROM per_race) SELECT pr.raceId, c.country, COALESCE(pr.total_points, 0) AS total_constructor_points, pr.entries, pr.entries - a.avg_entries AS diff_from_avg FROM per_race pr CROSS JOIN avg_e a JOIN races r ON r.raceId = pr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE pr.entries > a.avg_entries ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId, COUNT(cr.constructorResultsId) AS entries, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM races r LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.circuitId), avg_e AS (SELECT AVG(entries) AS avg_entries FROM per_race) SELECT pr.raceId, c.country, COALESCE(pr.total_points, 0) AS total_constructor_points, pr.entries, pr.entries - a.avg_entries AS diff_from_avg FROM per_race pr CROSS JOIN avg_e a JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = pr.circuitId WHERE pr.entries > a.avg_entries ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, entry_count - (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) AS diff_above_avg FROM per_race WHERE entry_count > (SELECT AVG(entry_count) FROM per_race) ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH cat AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS rel_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.rel_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cat.n) AS avg_budget_lines, AVG(cat.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM cat CROSS JOIN a WHERE cat.n > a.avg_n

WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 THEN (spent - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0) END) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count FROM cat), kept AS (SELECT cat.category, cat.avg_rel_overspend, cat.line_count, overall.avg_line_count FROM cat CROSS JOIN overall WHERE cat.line_count > overall.avg_line_count) SELECT AVG(avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_of_avg_rel_overspend, AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count_of_kept, AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM kept;
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY share DESC, customer_id ASC LIMIT 10

WITH per_customer AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC) AS rnk FROM per_customer) SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY order_share DESC, customer_id;

WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(CAST(g - l AS REAL) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_g_minus_l_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_g_minus_l_per_loss, t.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS gap_above_mean FROM t, m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_wins ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH team_avg AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_g_minus_l_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM team_avg) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_g_minus_l_ratio, t.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean FROM team_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_wins > o.mean_avg_wins ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, attendees, attendees * 1.0 / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.attendees) AS avg_attendees, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share
alternatives: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendees FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, attendees, attendees * 1.0 / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.attendees) AS avg_attendees, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - av.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share

sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code GROUP BY z.city), shares AS (SELECT city, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM city_counts) AS share FROM city_counts), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_overall_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_all a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH j AS (SELECT e.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), m AS (SELECT AVG(igm) AS mu FROM j), d AS (SELECT j.ID, j.SEX, j.igm, j.igm - m.mu AS dev FROM j CROSS JOIN m), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev FROM d WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID AS ID, d.SEX AS SEX, d.igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation_from_overall_mean, d.dev - s.avg_dev AS excess_over_sex_avg_deviation FROM d JOIN s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.dev > s.avg_dev ORDER BY excess_over_sex_avg_deviation DESC LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID), d AS (SELECT ID, SEX, igm, igm - AVG(igm) OVER () AS dev FROM j), s AS (SELECT ID, SEX, igm, dev, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS sex_avg_dev FROM d) SELECT ID, SEX, igm AS `aCL IgM`, dev AS deviation_from_overall_mean, dev - sex_avg_dev AS excess_over_sex_avg_deviation FROM s WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND dev > sex_avg_dev ORDER BY dev - sex_avg_dev DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `ANA Pattern` HAVING AVG(`aCL IgG`) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall FROM p), a AS (SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_igg, o.overall FROM p JOIN o ON p.avg_igg > o.overall) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - overall AS above_overall_avg, avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM a) AS diff_from_above_group_avg FROM a ORDER BY avg_igg DESC;

WITH g AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_mean FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg FROM g, m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.overall_mean), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS kept_mean FROM k) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg AS avg_aCL_IgG, k.avg_igg - m.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, k.avg_igg - km.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k, m, km ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS a FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.a) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, avg_amount - (SELECT a FROM overall) AS above_overall_avg, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_avg_mean FROM above ORDER BY gap_from_above_avg_mean DESC LIMIT 10;
alternatives: WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS a FROM ev), above AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount FROM ev, overall WHERE ev.avg_amount > overall.a) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, avg_amount - (SELECT a FROM overall) AS above_overall_avg, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM above) AS gap_from_above_avg_mean FROM above ORDER BY gap_from_above_avg_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

sql: WITH per_event AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event HAVING AVG(amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_event), kept AS (SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount, o.overall_avg FROM per_event p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.link_to_event, k.avg_amount, k.avg_amount - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_amount - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS sz FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(sz) AS avg_sz FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, SUM(g.sz) AS combined_size, AVG(g.sz - a.avg_sz) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.sz > a.avg_sz
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS sz FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(sz) AS avg_sz FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios, SUM(g.sz) AS combined_size, AVG(g.sz - a.avg_sz) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.sz > a.avg_sz

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(g.n) AS total_spatial_records, AVG(g.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.n > a.avg_n

WITH t AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), av AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS m FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - av.m) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM t CROSS JOIN av WHERE t.total > av.m

WITH t AS (SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' AND a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), m AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - m.av) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE t.total > m.av

WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), o AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS mean_of_timing_avgs, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS grp_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm HAVING AVG(instownpct) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.grp_avg) AS mean_of_timing_avgs, AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_average FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall_avg

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_inst) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_inst) AS mean_of_above_avgs, AVG(g.avg_inst - b.baseline) AS mean_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_inst > b.baseline

SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_customers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0) OVER () AS multiple_of_avg_store_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM telescopes t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation, o.overall_avg HAVING AVG(t.bandusagepct) > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH st AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall_avg FROM st) SELECT st.observstation, st.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage, st.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM st CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE st.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) AS average_excess_over_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.mean_share
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) AS average_excess_over_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.mean_share

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT cnt, 1.0*cnt/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_members, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH agg AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, entries, entries - AVG(entries) OVER () AS entries_diff_from_avg FROM agg ORDER BY nationality

WITH n AS (SELECT c.nationality AS nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS result_records FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, result_records, result_records - (SELECT AVG(result_records * 1.0) FROM n) AS diff_from_avg_records FROM n

WITH cat AS (SELECT c.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS ad FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories c ON c.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY c.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(ad) AS mad FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.aq) AS avg_quantity, AVG(cat.ad) AS avg_difference, AVG(cat.ad - m.mad) AS avg_excess FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.ad > m.mad;
alternatives: WITH cat AS (SELECT c.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS aq, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost - ili.derived_product_cost) AS ad FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories c ON c.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY c.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(ad) AS mad FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.aq) AS avg_quantity, AVG(cat.ad) AS avg_difference, AVG(cat.ad - m.mad) AS avg_excess FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.ad > m.mad;

sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) AS avg_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(cat.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_diff, AVG(cat.avg_diff - m.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.avg_diff > m.mean_diff

SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS v FROM Products), k AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t JOIN o ON t.a > o.v), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a FROM k JOIN m ON k.a > m.v) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(f.a - o.v) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(f.a - m.v) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM f CROSS JOIN o CROSS JOIN m

WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), base AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t JOIN base b ON b.baseline IS NOT NULL WHERE t.avg_price > b.baseline), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS m FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.avg_price FROM kept k JOIN kept_mean km ON k.avg_price > km.m) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - b.baseline) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(f.avg_price - km.m) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f CROSS JOIN base b CROSS JOIN kept_mean km;
SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS share FROM signals GROUP BY telescref ORDER BY signal_count DESC, telescref LIMIT 10
SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signals) AS fraction FROM signals GROUP BY telescref ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), r AS (SELECT mix, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT mix, cnt AS count, share, share - avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM r WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH linked AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS txn_count FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / SUM(txn_count) OVER () AS share FROM linked), base AS (SELECT ordertypedist, txn_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM shares) SELECT ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, txn_count AS distinct_transaction_count, share, share - baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM base WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

WITH r AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark FROM r) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.benchmark AS gap FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.rate > b.benchmark ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH r AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS benchmark FROM r) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.rate, r.rate - b.benchmark AS gap FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.rate > b.benchmark ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT > 0 GROUP BY ID), a AS (SELECT ID, r, r - (SELECT AVG(r) FROM p) AS d1 FROM p WHERE r > (SELECT AVG(r) FROM p)), b AS (SELECT ID, r, d1, r - (SELECT AVG(r) FROM a) AS d2 FROM a WHERE r > (SELECT AVG(r) FROM a)) SELECT AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_group FROM b;
alternatives: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, Date, HGB / HCT AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT > 0), a AS (SELECT ID, Date, r, r - (SELECT AVG(r) FROM p) AS d1 FROM p WHERE r > (SELECT AVG(r) FROM p)), b AS (SELECT ID, Date, r, d1, r - (SELECT AVG(r) FROM a) AS d2 FROM a WHERE r > (SELECT AVG(r) FROM a)) SELECT AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_group FROM b;

sql: WITH r AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg1 FROM r), k1 AS (SELECT r.ID, r.ratio, r.ratio - a1.avg1 AS diff1 FROM r, a1 WHERE r.ratio > a1.avg1), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.ID, k1.ratio, k1.diff1, k1.ratio - a2.avg2 AS diff2 FROM k1, a2 WHERE k1.ratio > a2.avg2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff1) AS avg_above_overall_avg, AVG(diff2) AS avg_above_second_avg FROM k2

WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_anlycount, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM o WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
alternatives: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT corpeventprx, avg_anlycount, avg_gap, avg_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM o WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL

sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx AS event_type, g.avg_anlycount AS avg_analyst_count, g.avg_diff AS avg_insider_minus_institutional_pct, g.avg_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_vs_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(m.facetfaces) AS overall_avg FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS st_avg FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_face_count, AVG(sa.avg_faces - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(sa.avg_faces - st.st_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_avg sa JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE sa.avg_faces > st.st_avg AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
alternatives: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS overall_avg FROM site_avg), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS st_avg FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_face_count, AVG(sa.avg_faces - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(sa.avg_faces - st.st_avg) AS avg_above_status FROM site_avg sa JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE sa.avg_faces > st.st_avg AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

sql: WITH site_avg AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, AVG(m.facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat HAVING AVG(m.facetfaces) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS b FROM site_avg), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS sa FROM site_avg WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT a.avg_faces, a.avg_faces - bl.b AS over_base, a.avg_faces - st.sa AS over_status FROM site_avg a CROSS JOIN baseline bl JOIN status_avg st ON st.entrystat = a.entrystat WHERE bl.b IS NOT NULL AND a.avg_faces > st.sa) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_kept_face_avg, AVG(over_base) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(over_status) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept

WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(p.field_size - o.avg_field) AS avg_excess_field_size FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.field_size > o.avg_field
alternatives: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS field_size FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(p.field_size - o.avg_field) AS avg_excess_field_size FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.field_size > o.avg_field

sql: WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT ds.driverId) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(p.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.cnt > o.avg_cnt

WITH combo AS (SELECT t.tradekind, a.translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM combo), marked AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_margin FROM marked WHERE share >= avg_share GROUP BY tradekind
alternatives: WITH combo AS (SELECT t.tradekind, a.translink, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind, a.translink), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM combo), marked AS (SELECT tradekind, translink, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_margin FROM marked WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind

sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pairs), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind AS trader_type, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_type_avg FROM scored WHERE share > avg_share GROUP BY tradekind

WITH c AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '') AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS n FROM player_college pc JOIN college co ON co.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '')), t AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS avg_n, SUM(n) * 1.0 AS total_n FROM c) SELECT c.state, AVG(c.n * 1.0) AS avg_player_count, AVG(c.n / t.avg_n) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_avg, AVG(c.n / t.total_n) AS avg_share_of_total FROM c CROSS JOIN t GROUP BY c.state

WITH c AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '') AS state, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college co ON co.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state), ''), '')), t AS (SELECT state, cnt, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_all, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS tot FROM c) SELECT state, AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(cnt / avg_all) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_avg, AVG(cnt / tot) AS avg_share_of_total FROM t GROUP BY state

WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT region, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), s AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM r) AS share FROM r), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share_above, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c ORDER BY death_country;

WITH g AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g

WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune, o.recordvault FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), c AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY ordertune), s AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
alternatives: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), c AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY ordertune), s AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), s AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM j), a AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_mean AS margin FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.overall_mean), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER () AS relative_to_mean FROM per_type ORDER BY tradekind

sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS m FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.m AS above FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.m), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(above) AS avg_above_mean FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_above_mean, avg_anlycount / AVG(avg_anlycount) OVER () AS relative_to_type_mean FROM per_type

WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.n) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings, AVG(r.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.n > a.avg_n

WITH counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM counts) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count_above, AVG(c.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM counts c CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE c.cnt > o.avg_cnt

WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), inv2 AS (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv2) SELECT AVG(inv2.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv2.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv2.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv2 CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv2.ratio > o.overall;
alternatives: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number), inv2 AS (SELECT * FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv2) SELECT AVG(inv2.avg_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(inv2.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(inv2.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM inv2 CROSS JOIN o WHERE inv2.ratio > o.overall;

sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv) SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(ratio) - (SELECT overall FROM o) AS ratio_excess_over_overall FROM inv WHERE ratio > (SELECT overall FROM o)

WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM a) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM a CROSS JOIN o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END), 0) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM a) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM a CROSS JOIN o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM album_rates) AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_rates ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), f AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count * 1.0 / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM c) SELECT actor_id, film_count, fraction, fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_fraction FROM f ORDER BY diff_from_avg_fraction DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH c AS (SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(fa.film_id) AS film_count FROM actor a LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id), f AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, film_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film) AS fraction FROM c) SELECT actor_id, film_count, fraction, fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_fraction FROM f ORDER BY diff_from_avg_fraction DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_actor AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), shares AS (SELECT actor_id, film_count, CAST(film_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM per_actor) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM shares ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relgap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), g AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(relgap) AS avg_relative_gap FROM j GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune), o AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg FROM j) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_rebate > o.overall_avg ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH j AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relgap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), g AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(relgap) AS avg_relative_gap FROM j GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_rebate > o.overall_avg ORDER BY above_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, f.rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS relgap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), base AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS baseline FROM matched), grp AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(relgap) AS avg_relative_gap FROM matched GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - b.baseline AS excess_over_baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.baseline ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS circuit_avg FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), co AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.circuit_avg AS avg_round, cc.circuit_avg - co.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN co ON co.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH cc AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, AVG(ra.round) AS circuit_avg FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId GROUP BY ra.circuitId, c.country), co AS (SELECT country, AVG(circuit_avg) AS country_avg FROM cc GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.circuit_avg AS avg_round, cc.circuit_avg - co.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN co ON co.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH c AS (SELECT r.circuitId AS circuitId, ci.country AS country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, ci.country), b AS (SELECT c.*, AVG(avg_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS baseline FROM c) SELECT circuitId, country, avg_round, avg_round - baseline AS diff FROM b ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq), ab AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, ov.overall_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN ov WHERE eq.avg_hum > ov.overall_avg), gm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM ab) SELECT ab.equipref, ab.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, ab.avg_hum - ab.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, ab.avg_hum - gm.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM ab CROSS JOIN gm WHERE ab.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND gm.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
alternatives: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(humepct) AS overall_avg FROM scanenvironment), ab AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, ov.overall_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN ov WHERE eq.avg_hum > ov.overall_avg), gm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM ab) SELECT ab.equipref, ab.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, ab.avg_hum - ab.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, ab.avg_hum - gm.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM ab CROSS JOIN gm WHERE ab.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND gm.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

sql: WITH per_equip AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM per_equip), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_hum, o.overall_avg FROM per_equip p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hum > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, k.avg_hum - k.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall_avg, k.avg_hum - m.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH v AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, CAST(a.points_won AS REAL)/a.points_max AS share FROM player_award_vote a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.points_max IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max <> 0 AND a.points_won IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM v GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_share, avg_share / (SELECT AVG(avg_share) FROM c) AS relative_ratio FROM c ORDER BY death_country

WITH v AS (SELECT p.player_id, COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS c, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL) / v.points_max AS r FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0), pa AS (SELECT c, player_id, AVG(r) AS a FROM v GROUP BY c, player_id), ca AS (SELECT c, AVG(a) AS avg_ratio FROM pa GROUP BY c) SELECT c AS death_country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM ca) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM ca;

WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg), excess AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope FROM excess) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope
alternatives: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg), excess AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope FROM excess) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope

sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk, orderslink

WITH w AS (SELECT DISTINCT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS bats FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id) SELECT bats, COUNT(*) AS num_managers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w) AS share FROM w GROUP BY bats

WITH c AS (SELECT p.product_color, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items i JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), s AS (SELECT product_color, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH rental_totals AS (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id), store_avg AS (SELECT store_id, AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM rental_totals GROUP BY store_id) SELECT t.store_id, SUM(t.total) AS total_payment_sum, AVG(t.total - s.avg_total) AS avg_excess FROM rental_totals t JOIN store_avg s ON s.store_id = t.store_id WHERE t.total > s.avg_total GROUP BY t.store_id

WITH g AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color), r AS (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, avg_quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM g) SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, rnk FROM r WHERE rnk <= 3

WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amt) AS mean_of_avg, AVG(r.txn_cnt) AS mean_txn_count, AVG(r.avg_amt - m.mean_avg) AS mean_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.avg_amt > m.mean_avg

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_replacement_cost, avg_per_day_price, avg_per_day_price / AVG(avg_per_day_price) OVER () AS ratio_to_mean_of_ratings FROM r

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS avg_excess FROM album_rates a CROSS JOIN m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate

WITH per_name AS (SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_name HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_name) SELECT p.event_name, p.avg_amount AS avg_budget_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), avg_r AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ev) SELECT ev.event_id, ev.spend_ratio, ev.spend_ratio / avg_r.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM ev CROSS JOIN avg_r ORDER BY (ev.spend_ratio / avg_r.avg_ratio) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), s AS (SELECT c, c * 1.0 / SUM(c) OVER () AS share, AVG(c * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_c FROM g) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_invoices, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(c - avg_c) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE c > avg_c
