WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), cdev AS (SELECT dev.*, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_avg_dev FROM dev) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, deviation, deviation - country_avg_dev AS deviation_minus_country_avg FROM cdev ORDER BY (deviation - country_avg_dev) IS NULL, (deviation - country_avg_dev) DESC, InvoiceId LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH per AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), sh AS (SELECT gender, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM per), av AS (SELECT gender, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT gender, cnt AS order_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM av WHERE share > avg_share

WITH s AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(g.pulsepersec) AS avg_p FROM signals g JOIN telescopes t ON g.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE g.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_p) AS mean1 FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.equipstatus, s.avg_p, s.avg_p - m1.mean1 AS ex1, m1.mean1 FROM s CROSS JOIN m1 WHERE s.avg_p > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_p) AS mean2 FROM k) SELECT AVG(k.avg_p) AS avg_pulse_rate_average, AVG(k.ex1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(k.avg_p - m2.mean2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN m2 WHERE k.avg_p > m2.mean2

WITH acct AS (
  SELECT a.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region,
         SUM(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS account_sum,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
)
SELECT account_id, region, account_sum, txn_count,
       CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share_of_region
FROM acct
ORDER BY (CAST(account_sum AS REAL) / SUM(account_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) IS NULL,
         share_of_region DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(cnt) AS total_distinct_orders, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean1 FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins, ca.avg_wins - m1.mean1 AS excess1 FROM country_avg ca, m1 WHERE ca.avg_wins > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean2 FROM above), final AS (SELECT a.avg_wins, a.excess1, a.avg_wins - m2.mean2 AS excess2 FROM above a, m2 WHERE a.avg_wins > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(excess1) AS mean_excess_over_all_country_mean, AVG(excess2) AS mean_excess_over_above_group_mean FROM final;

WITH rc AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), ca AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg FROM rc), kept AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, city_avg, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total_kept FROM ca WHERE cnt > city_avg) SELECT City, SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt - city_avg) AS avg_excess_over_city_avg, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total_kept) AS avg_share FROM kept GROUP BY City

WITH tx AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS base_short
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transreg, tx.ordertypedist, tx.avg_short, tx.avg_opt,
  tx.avg_short / NULLIF(b.base_short, 0) AS ratio
FROM tx
LEFT JOIN base b ON b.ordertypedist IS NOT DISTINCT FROM tx.ordertypedist
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH line AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total FROM line) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS avg_total_of_above_avg_lines, SUM(l.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - o.avg_total) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM line l CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE l.total_cost > o.avg_total;
SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(UnitPrice) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT bats, cnt, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT bats, cnt AS player_count, cnt * 1.0 / total AS share_of_total, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH c AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), s AS (SELECT c.city_id, c.address_count, c.address_count * 1.0 / AVG(c.address_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average, c.address_count * 1.0 / SUM(c.address_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM c), r AS (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_of_total DESC) AS rnk FROM s) SELECT city_id, address_count, ratio_to_average, share_of_total FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, city_id

WITH per_op AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref HAVING AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS overall_avg FROM per_op) SELECT AVG(p.total_scans) AS avg_total_scans, AVG(p.avg_gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(p.avg_gb_per_min - o.overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM per_op p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_gb_per_min > o.overall_avg

WITH g AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS n FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, n AS appearance_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM g

SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref) AS avg_imgcount_minus_overall FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), avg_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates) SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate AS rate, r.rate - a.avg_rate AS diff_above_average FROM rates r CROSS JOIN avg_rate a WHERE r.rate > a.avg_rate ORDER BY diff_above_average DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s), d AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM a WHERE share > avg_share), r AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC) AS rnk FROM d) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, diff_above_avg FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC;

WITH pr AS (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, SUM(s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), x AS (SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS excess FROM pr) SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, excess FROM x ORDER BY excess IS NULL, excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT r.name AS name, SUM(res.points) AS tp FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), a AS (SELECT AVG(tp) AS avgtp FROM t), k AS (SELECT t.name AS name, t.tp AS tp FROM t, a WHERE t.tp > a.avgtp) SELECT (SELECT SUM(tp) FROM k) AS total_points_sum, (SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) FROM results res JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE r.name IN (SELECT name FROM k) AND res.laps IS NOT NULL) AS avg_laps_all_results, (SELECT AVG(k.tp - a.avgtp) FROM k, a) AS avg_excess_over_average_total

WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_cnt FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), site_cmp AS (SELECT zoneregistry, insurstat, ratio, mesh_cnt, AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY insurstat) AS status_avg FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_cnt) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM site_cmp WHERE ratio > status_avg GROUP BY insurstat

WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS d1, AVG(L.APTT - L.PT) AS d2 FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(d1) AS a1, AVG(d2) AS a2 FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(a2) AS mean2 FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.a1) AS avg_alb_minus_tp, AVG(s.a2) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt, AVG(s.a2) - m.mean2 AS excess_over_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.a2 > m.mean2

WITH per_acct AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_volume, COUNT(*) AS num_transactions FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, total_volume, num_transactions, CAST(total_volume AS REAL) / SUM(total_volume) OVER () AS volume_share FROM per_acct ORDER BY volume_share DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customers cu JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, n AS order_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH tot AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS total FROM scanfeatures), unit AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(articount) AS artifact_count FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY zoneref), sh AS (SELECT u.zoneref, u.artifact_count, (1.0 * u.artifact_count) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) AS share FROM unit u CROSS JOIN tot t), withavg AS (SELECT zoneref, artifact_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, artifact_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM withavg WHERE avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (share - avg_share) IS NULL, share - avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT cs.constructorId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings cs GROUP BY cs.constructorId) SELECT c.constructorId, k.nationality, c.cnt AS record_count, c.cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM c) AS difference_from_average FROM c LEFT JOIN constructors k ON k.constructorId = c.constructorId ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate) * 1.0 / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_of_avg_length, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.per_day - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.per_day > m.mean_pd

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS og FROM Laboratory), per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.og AS diff FROM per p JOIN overall o ON o.og IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM dc) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district di ON di.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY di.A3

WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.*, a.avg_share FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM k

WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id) SELECT team_id, total_games, total_games * 1.0 / SUM(total_games) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, total_games * 1.0 / AVG(total_games) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM t ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT st.riskeval AS grp, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY st.riskeval), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench

WITH c AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), s AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, account_count * 1.0 / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT district_id, account_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM s), r AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC) AS rnk FROM d) SELECT district_id, account_count, share, diff_from_avg FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC, district_id

WITH cnt AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM `order` o
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = o.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count,
         order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg
  FROM cnt
),
reg AS (
  SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff_from_avg,
         AVG(diff_from_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff
  FROM diffs
)
SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff_from_avg,
       diff_from_avg - region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg
FROM reg
WHERE diff_from_avg > region_avg_diff
ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(CASE WHEN b.amount <> 0 THEN (b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount END) AS avg_overspend FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS overall_avg_remaining FROM ev) SELECT ev.status, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ev.avg_overspend) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) / (SELECT overall_avg_remaining FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY ev.status;

WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), t AS (SELECT type, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM t) AS ratio_to_mean FROM t;

WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS trans_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM trans) AS ratio FROM trans GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, oe.orderexecmark, oe.fillcount, o.recordvault FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault), g AS (SELECT channel, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count FROM j GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, avg_fillcount, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM g

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID) SELECT ID, avg_ana, avg_ana - (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM g) AS excess FROM g WHERE avg_ana > (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM g) ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), f AS (SELECT ID, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS frac FROM g), a AS (SELECT ID, n, frac, AVG(frac) OVER () AS avg_frac FROM f) SELECT ID, n AS num_examinations, frac AS fraction, frac - avg_frac AS excess_over_average FROM a WHERE frac > avg_frac ORDER BY excess_over_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH m AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), g AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net) AS a FROM m GROUP BY mktnote), b AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS bm FROM m) SELECT AVG(g.a) AS avg_of_pair_avg_net_rate, AVG(g.a - b.bm) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.a > b.bm

WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS bench FROM ch) SELECT AVG(ch.avg_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(ch.avg_rate - b.bench) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM ch CROSS JOIN b WHERE ch.avg_rate > b.bench

WITH d AS (SELECT c.district_id, di.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client c JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, di.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, client_count * 1.0 / SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS share_of_region, client_count * 1.0 / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM d ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, district_id LIMIT 10

WITH counts AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), shares AS (SELECT rating, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.a) AS avg_excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.a

WITH per_state AS (SELECT p.death_state AS death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_state) SELECT AVG(ps.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(ps.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_state ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.cnt > o.avg_cnt

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS overall FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.overall AS above_overall FROM p, o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.overall) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH matched AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, order_count * 1.0 / AVG(order_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM matched

WITH c AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_all FROM c), k AS (SELECT c.account_id, c.cnt, c.cnt - a.avg_all AS above_avg FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_all), k2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept FROM k) SELECT k.account_id, k.cnt AS order_count, k.above_avg AS diff_from_avg, k.cnt - k2.avg_kept AS diff_from_kept_avg FROM k, k2 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH s AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), t AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, project_count * 1.0 / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM s), u AS (SELECT archstat, project_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT archstat, project_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM u WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

SELECT o.orderflow, AVG(NULLIF(e.fillcount, 0)) AS avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS execution_fraction FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), sh AS (SELECT s, s * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(s) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.s) AS total_amount, AVG(sh.share) AS avg_share, AVG(sh.share - a.av) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM sh CROSS JOIN a WHERE sh.share > a.av

WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_bal) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS v FROM orderexecutions), above1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_remain FROM per_order p, b1 WHERE p.avg_remain > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS v FROM above1), above2 AS (SELECT a.avg_remain FROM above1 a, b2 WHERE a.avg_remain > b2.v) SELECT AVG(a.avg_remain) AS avg_of_averages, AVG(a.avg_remain - b1.v) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(a.avg_remain - b2.v) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM above2 a, b1, b2
SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share FROM account GROUP BY district_id ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share_above_avg, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(CAST(HGB AS REAL) / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM p WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE p.ratio > o.overall

SELECT c.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS matched_records, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_college) AS fraction_of_all_records FROM player_college pc JOIN college c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY c.state

WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS base FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.avg_conf, b.base FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_conf > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_q FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS avg_modelconf, q.avg_conf - q.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / m.mean_q AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN m WHERE q.base IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_q IS NOT NULL

WITH m AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, 1.0 * SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM m) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_price, AVG(m.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(m.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM m CROSS JOIN a WHERE m.rate > a.avg_rate

WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.Name) SELECT Name, rate, rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates) AS rate_ratio_to_mean FROM rates

WITH c AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM c), s1 AS (SELECT c.film_id, c.n, c.n - a1.m AS e1 FROM c, a1 WHERE c.n > a1.m), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.film_id, s1.n, s1.e1, s1.n - a2.m AS e2 FROM s1, a2 WHERE s1.n > a2.m) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_actor_count, AVG(e1) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(e2) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM s2

WITH c AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.position, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position), s AS (SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, attendance_count * 1.0 / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), r AS (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rnk FROM s) SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, member_id
SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS avg_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_averages FROM t;

WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - a.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.rate > a.mean_rate

WITH c AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS n FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT SUM(c.n) AS total_films, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n

WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS a FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_scans, AVG(s.rate - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.rate > o.a

WITH g AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT SEX, cnt AS test_count, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS fraction_of_total, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM g) AS above_average FROM g WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM g)

WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), r AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rnk FROM s) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC, observstation

WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_c FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.cnt - a.avg_c) AS avg_excess FROM side_counts s CROSS JOIN avg_cnt a WHERE s.cnt > a.avg_c

WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acct_avg) AS figure FROM acct GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS all_avg FROM reg), above AS (SELECT r.region, r.figure FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.all_avg), above_avg AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS a_avg FROM above) SELECT ab.region, ab.figure, ab.figure - o.all_avg AS excess_over_all_region_avg, ab.figure / aa.a_avg AS ratio_to_above_avg FROM above ab CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN above_avg aa ORDER BY ab.figure DESC;

SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

WITH hands AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT bats, player_count, player_count * 1.0 / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hands), avg_share AS (SELECT bats, player_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT bats, player_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM avg_share WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), s AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM c), a AS (SELECT c.cnt, s.avg_cnt, s.total_cnt FROM c, s WHERE c.cnt > s.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total_cnt) AS avg_share_of_total, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM a

WITH c AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), s AS (SELECT order_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_invoices, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amt_avg, AVG(t.balance) AS bal_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), reg AS (SELECT region, AVG(amt_avg) AS avg_amount_avg, AVG(bal_avg) AS avg_balance_avg FROM acc GROUP BY region) SELECT region, avg_amount_avg, avg_balance_avg, avg_amount_avg / (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_avg) FROM reg) AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM reg WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_amount_avg) FROM reg) IS NOT NULL

WITH pa AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), idx AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / AVG(avg_doubles) OVER () AS idx FROM pa), d AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS idx_minus_hand_avg FROM idx) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx_minus_hand_avg FROM d WHERE bats IS NOT NULL ORDER BY idx_minus_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST, player_id LIMIT 10

WITH per_account AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS acct_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), with_freq AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, acct_avg, AVG(acct_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS freq_avg FROM per_account) SELECT account_id, frequency, acct_avg, acct_avg / NULLIF(freq_avg, 0) AS ratio FROM with_freq ORDER BY (acct_avg / NULLIF(freq_avg, 0)) IS NULL, ratio DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff,
         AVG(s.aream2 / NULLIF(s.volm3, 0)) AS avg_area_to_volume
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       avg_y_vs_x_diff,
       avg_area_to_volume,
       avg_area_to_volume - (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) FROM per_source) AS excess_over_cross_source_avg
FROM per_source
WHERE avg_area_to_volume > (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) FROM per_source);
SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proportion FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status

WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_cnt FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT healtheval, site_cnt, site_cnt * 1.0 / SUM(site_cnt) OVER () AS share FROM per_status), with_avg AS (SELECT healtheval, site_cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(site_cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS baseline FROM per_order) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty AS avg_quantity, p.avg_qty - b.baseline AS diff_from_baseline FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN base b WHERE b.baseline IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_qty - b.baseline) IS NULL, p.avg_qty - b.baseline DESC, p.order_id LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), st AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM j GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandusagepct, SUM(n_tel) AS telescope_count, 1.0 * SUM(n_tel) / SUM(SUM(n_tel)) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM st GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH per AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, n_orders, n_orders - (SELECT AVG(n_orders * 1.0) FROM per) AS diff_from_avg FROM per ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM r), k1 AS (SELECT r.rating, r.a, b.base FROM r CROSS JOIN b WHERE r.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mean1 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.base, m.mean1 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN m WHERE k1.a > m.mean1) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_avg_length, AVG(a - base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - mean1) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean FROM k2

SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, ma.player_id LIMIT 10

WITH item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town)

WITH t AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(1.0 * tr.Bytes / tr.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track tr JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = tr.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), o AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM t) SELECT AVG(t.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(t.cnt) AS avg_track_count, AVG(t.rate - o.overall) AS avg_excess FROM t CROSS JOIN o WHERE t.rate > o.overall

WITH g AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), s AS (SELECT ReportsTo, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM g) SELECT ReportsTo, n AS employee_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_share FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_avg_share DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM transactionrecord r JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT p.tradekind AS trader_type, p.cnt AS record_count, p.cnt * 1.0 / s.total_cnt AS share_of_total, p.cnt - s.avg_cnt AS diff_from_avg FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE s.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND p.cnt > s.avg_cnt

SELECT sc.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_records, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction_of_matched FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction_of_matched DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS avg_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.per_day) AS avg_per_day_of_above_average_ratings, AVG(p.per_day - o.avg_per_day) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.per_day > o.avg_per_day

WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt

WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.a FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.a > b.base) SELECT k.rfistat, k.a AS avg_modindex, k.a - b.base AS above_baseline, k.a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN b

WITH j AS (SELECT e.ordersmark, o.timespan, e.fillcount, AVG(e.fillcount) OVER (PARTITION BY o.timespan) AS tif_avg FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill, MAX(tif_avg) AS tif_avg FROM j GROUP BY ordersmark, timespan), ranked AS (SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, avg_fill - tif_avg AS excess_over_tif, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk, tif_avg FROM per_order) SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_over_tif, rnk FROM ranked WHERE avg_fill > tif_avg AND rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk, ordersmark

WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS n FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, n, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS sh FROM c), a AS (SELECT hand, n, sh, AVG(sh) OVER () AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE sh > av

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major) SELECT major_id, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, member_count * 1.0 / AVG(member_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_group_size FROM g ORDER BY ratio_to_avg_group_size DESC, major_id LIMIT 10

WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM per_sex) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

WITH c AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), s AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.circuitId, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess_over_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY excess_over_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH ds AS (SELECT s.raceId, r.circuitId, s.driverId, s.wins - COALESCE(LAG(s.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY s.driverId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS gained FROM driverStandings s JOIN races r ON r.raceId = s.raceId), per_race AS (SELECT raceId, circuitId, AVG(gained) AS race_avg FROM ds GROUP BY raceId, circuitId), per_country AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(p.race_avg) AS avg_wins FROM per_race p JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = p.circuitId GROUP BY c.country HAVING AVG(p.race_avg) IS NOT NULL), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m1 FROM per_country), kept AS (SELECT pc.country, pc.avg_wins, b.m1 FROM per_country pc, bench b WHERE pc.avg_wins > b.m1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m2 FROM kept) SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins AS average_wins, k.avg_wins - k.m1 AS above_overall_benchmark, k.avg_wins - m2.m2 AS above_second_mean FROM kept k, m2 WHERE k.avg_wins > m2.m2

WITH units AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS own
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
base AS (
  SELECT u.*, AVG(own) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_base,
         AVG(own) OVER () AS overall
  FROM units u
)
SELECT AVG(own) AS avg_ownership,
       AVG(own / NULLIF(mix_base, 0)) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline,
       AVG(own - overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM base
WHERE own > overall

WITH c AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS ordervault, o.orderflow AS orderflow, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY r.ordervault, o.orderflow), s AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY orderflow) AS diff FROM s), f AS (SELECT * FROM d WHERE share > share - diff), k AS (SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt, share, diff, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff DESC) AS rk FROM f) SELECT ordervault, orderflow, cnt AS record_count, share, diff AS share_minus_status_avg FROM k WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff DESC

WITH dept AS (SELECT m.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member me JOIN major m ON me.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM dept) AS share FROM dept), avg_s AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_s a WHERE s.share >= a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC

WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_invoice_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt

SELECT rating, avg_ratio, films, avg_ratio - AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_ratings FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film GROUP BY rating) t ORDER BY rating

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM g

WITH per_tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM per_tel) SELECT p.telescref, p.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, p.avg_mod - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall, p.avg_mod / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_tel p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_mod > o.overall_avg ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH base AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS b FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_opt, c.avg_opt - base.b AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_dev) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_dev GROUP BY tradekind

WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_min_rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min_rate) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scan_count, g.gb_per_min_rate, g.gb_per_min_rate - a.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min_rate > a.avg_rate

WITH c AS (SELECT f.film_id, f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies FROM film f JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating) SELECT film_id, rating, copies, copies - AVG(copies) OVER (PARTITION BY rating) AS diff_from_rating_avg, copies - AVG(copies) OVER () AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM c ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH u AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS units FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id), s AS (SELECT product_id, units, units * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(units) FROM u) AS share FROM u), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.units) AS combined_units, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_overall_average FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt::numeric / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT tradekind, cnt AS behaviour_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM g WHERE share > avg_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS b FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b
SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) * 1.0 / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY p.staff_id

WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), d AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s), r AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deviation DESC) AS rnk FROM d) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY deviation DESC

WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM linked), grp AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile) SELECT g.weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - b.baseline) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline GROUP BY g.weathprofile

WITH r AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.CPK * 1.0 / l.GPT) AS a FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM r), k AS (SELECT r.a AS a FROM r, m1 WHERE r.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a AS a FROM k, m2 WHERE k.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_ratio, AVG(a - (SELECT m FROM m1)) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(a - (SELECT m FROM m2)) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM f;

WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account a JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), ra AS (SELECT dc.*, AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg FROM dc), ab AS (SELECT * FROM ra WHERE account_count > region_avg) SELECT district_id, region, account_count, account_count - region_avg AS excess_over_region_avg, account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_overall_avg FROM ab ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH j AS (SELECT u.acctscope, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink), s AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM j GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, fee_record_count, avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS diff_from_mean_of_scope_averages FROM s

WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM b), t AS (SELECT timespan, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM t WHERE share > avg_share

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COALESCE(SUM(ft.transaction_amount), 0) AS total FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT st, total, total * 1.0 / SUM(total) OVER () AS share FROM state_totals), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.total) AS combined_total, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - av.a) AS average_excess_over_average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE s.share > av.a

WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), c AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(daily) OVER () AS avg_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(daily - avg_daily) AS avg_excess FROM c WHERE daily > avg_daily

WITH c AS (SELECT cu.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(a.account_id) AS cnt FROM Customers cu LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = cu.customer_id GROUP BY cu.state_county_province), s AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS combined_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM t WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT birth_country, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_player_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH c AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id), r AS (SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS rnk FROM c) SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id

WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT t.transreg, tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY t.transreg, tr.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS avg_share_per_pair FROM shares GROUP BY tradekind

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS overall_mean FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.SEX, AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_of_avg_pt, AVG(pp.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_diff, AVG(pp.avg_diff / o.overall_mean) AS avg_ratio FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o GROUP BY pp.SEX

WITH c AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), a AS (SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) AS avg_cnt) SELECT c.driverId, c.cnt AS qualifying_count, c.cnt / a.avg_cnt AS ratio FROM c, a ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT fundflux, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT fundflux, cnt AS spatial_record_count, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS excess_over_average FROM t WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

WITH per_acct AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS mean_avg FROM per_acct) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_amt AS avg_amount, p.avg_amt - m.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean FROM per_acct p CROSS JOIN m WHERE p.avg_amt > m.mean_avg ORDER BY diff_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_all_income FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college

WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), s AS (SELECT ID, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH per_invoice AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM per_invoice) SELECT p.invoice_number, p.avg_quantity, p.cost_ratio, p.avg_quantity - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM per_invoice p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_quantity > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT ma.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id GROUP BY ma.department), s AS (SELECT department, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark HAVING AVG(fillcount) IS NOT NULL), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per_order), k1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.a, p.a - b1.m AS e1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE p.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.e1, k1.a - b2.m AS e2 FROM k1 CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM k2

WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS share FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id ORDER BY share DESC, film_id LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT o.timespan AS time_in_force, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT time_in_force, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT time_in_force, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff_from_avg FROM s ORDER BY time_in_force

WITH c AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS n FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), s AS (SELECT account_id, n, n * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share FROM c), m AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.n) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - m.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.share > m.avg_share

WITH item_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS ptd, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM Order_Items oi JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), shares AS (SELECT ptd, avg_qty, item_cnt, item_cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(item_cnt) FROM item_stats) AS share FROM item_stats), per_type AS (SELECT ptd, AVG(avg_qty) AS a_qty, AVG(item_cnt) AS a_cnt, AVG(share) AS a_share FROM shares GROUP BY ptd) SELECT AVG(a_qty) AS avg_quantity, AVG(a_cnt) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(a_share) AS avg_share FROM per_type;

WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_product_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), x AS (SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, AVG(cost_ratio) OVER () AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, cost_ratio / NULLIF(avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM x WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (relative_ratio IS NULL), relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(remaining) - (SELECT AVG(remaining) FROM budget) AS diff FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remain, AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remain, g.avg_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remain / m.mean_avg AS ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT event_id, location, avg_ratio, rnk FROM (SELECT e.event_id, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(e.location), ''), '') ORDER BY (AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) IS NULL), AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM event e JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.location) WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(location), ''), ''), rnk, event_id

WITH per_coin AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(NULLIF(rebtotal, 0)) AS avg_reb, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0) END) AS avg_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS b FROM per_coin), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_reb, p.avg_gap, b.b FROM per_coin p CROSS JOIN bench b WHERE p.avg_reb > b.b) SELECT AVG(avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_total_rebate, AVG(avg_gap) AS avg_of_avg_relative_gap, AVG(avg_reb - b) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM kept

WITH d AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS diff FROM budget WHERE amount - spent IS NOT NULL), b AS (SELECT AVG(diff) AS base FROM d) SELECT d.event_status, AVG(d.diff) AS avg_diff, AVG(d.diff) - b.base AS diff_from_baseline FROM d CROSS JOIN b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.event_status, b.base

WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt, o.overall_avg FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - k.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall_avg, k.avg_cnt - ka.kept_avg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT ci.location AS location, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count FROM races r JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM qualifying q WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId) GROUP BY ci.location), s AS (SELECT location, race_count, race_count * 1.0 / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share FROM c), t AS (SELECT location, race_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT location, race_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_avg FROM t WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC

WITH p AS (SELECT pt.ID, pt.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS alb, AVG(l.UN * 1.0 / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient pt ON pt.ID = l.ID GROUP BY pt.ID, pt.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM s) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - m.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM s CROSS JOIN m WHERE s.avg_alb > m.mean_alb

WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage AS phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(DISTINCT o.observstation) AS n_st FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_avg FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.avg_bw, g.n_st, m.mean_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_bw > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_kept_averages, SUM(n_st) AS total_distinct_stations, AVG(avg_bw - mean_avg) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM k

WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM c) AS avg_wins_minus_mean_of_country_avgs FROM c

WITH acct AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Financial_Transactions ft WHERE ft.account_id = a.account_id) AS txn_count FROM Accounts a JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL), stats AS (SELECT acct.*, SUM(txn_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town_city) AS town_total, AVG(txn_count * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_txn FROM acct) SELECT account_id, town_city, txn_count, CASE WHEN town_total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE txn_count * 1.0 / town_total END AS share_of_town, CASE WHEN avg_txn = 0 THEN NULL ELSE txn_count / avg_txn END AS ratio_to_avg FROM stats ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_patient AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(l.WBC) AS avg_wbc, AVG(l.HGB) / AVG(l.HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.avg_wbc, pp.ratio, pp.ratio - o.mean_ratio AS diff_from_mean FROM per_patient pp CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE pp.ratio > o.mean_ratio ORDER BY diff_from_mean DESC, pp.ID LIMIT 10;

WITH maj AS (
  SELECT m.major_id, m.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count,
         CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS share
  FROM member mem
  JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.major_id, m.department
),
dept AS (
  SELECT department, AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM maj
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT maj.major_id, maj.department, maj.member_count, maj.share,
       maj.share - dept.avg_share AS diff_above_avg
FROM maj
JOIN dept ON maj.department = dept.department
WHERE maj.share > dept.avg_share
ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS base FROM station_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_of_above_baseline_station_avgs, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.base

WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS v FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t, b1 WHERE t.avg_pulse > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS v FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k1.avg_pulse FROM k1, b2 WHERE k1.avg_pulse > b2.v) SELECT AVG(fin.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse, AVG(fin.avg_pulse - b1.v) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(fin.avg_pulse - b2.v) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM fin, b1, b2

WITH c AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), t AS (SELECT c.event_id, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / SUM(c.cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), r AS (SELECT event_id, cnt, share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM t) SELECT event_id, cnt AS attendance_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST, event_id

WITH g AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, exec_count * 1.0 / SUM(exec_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), d AS (SELECT ordersmark, exec_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_avg FROM s), r AS (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM d) SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, exec_count, share, share_minus_avg FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC NULLS LAST

WITH t AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), s AS (SELECT CustomerId, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.total) AS avg_total_spent, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG((s.share - a.avg_share) / a.avg_share) AS avg_relative_diff FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_totals), with_avg AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_avg FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM s ORDER BY share_diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_race AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), avg_cnt AS (SELECT AVG(entry_count) AS a FROM per_race), above AS (SELECT p.*, p.entry_count - (SELECT a FROM avg_cnt) AS diff FROM per_race p WHERE p.entry_count > (SELECT a FROM avg_cnt)), cutoff AS (SELECT entry_count AS cut FROM above ORDER BY entry_count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT raceId, country, total_points, entry_count, diff AS difference_above_average FROM above WHERE entry_count >= (SELECT cut FROM cutoff) ORDER BY diff DESC, raceId

WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_rel_overspend, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), g AS (SELECT AVG(line_count * 1.0) AS avg_lines FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_rel_overspend) AS avg_of_avg_rel_overspend, AVG(cat.line_count * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(cat.line_count - g.avg_lines) AS avg_excess_over_avg_line_count FROM cat CROSS JOIN g WHERE cat.line_count > g.avg_lines;
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) AS order_share FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY order_share DESC, customer_id LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, CAST(SUM(w) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins, AVG(CASE WHEN l <> 0 THEN CAST(g - l AS REAL) / l END) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS gap FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_wins ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10

WITH c AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), s AS (SELECT city, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), o AS (SELECT city, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM o WHERE share > avg_share

WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(E.`aCL IgM`) AS v FROM Examination E JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), d AS (SELECT ID, SEX, v, v - (SELECT AVG(v) FROM p) AS dev FROM p), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS ad FROM d GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.v AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation, d.dev - s.ad AS excess_over_sex_avg FROM d JOIN s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.dev > s.ad ORDER BY excess_over_sex_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '') AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(`ANA Pattern`), '')), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS overall_mean FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_igg FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_igg > m.overall_mean) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_igg, k.avg_igg - m.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean, k.avg_igg - (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k CROSS JOIN m ORDER BY k.avg_igg DESC

WITH ev AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND link_to_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT ev.link_to_event, ev.avg_amount, ev.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM ev CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ev.avg_amount > o.overall_avg) SELECT link_to_event, avg_amount, above_overall, avg_amount - (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n_proj FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(n_proj * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_n FROM g) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(n_proj) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(n_proj - avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE n_proj > avg_n

WITH t AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), m AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS av FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.total) AS sum_of_totals, AVG(t.total - m.av) AS avg_excess FROM t CROSS JOIN m WHERE t.total > m.av

WITH g AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_inst FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), b AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS base FROM sentimentandfundamentals) SELECT AVG(g.avg_inst) AS mean_of_group_averages, AVG(g.avg_inst - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_inst > b.base

SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS active_customers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_total, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS n FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord x ON x.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, n AS distinct_transactions, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t

WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(link_to_major) <> '' GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT link_to_major, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_selected, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH per_nat AS (SELECT c.nationality AS nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - (SELECT AVG(constructor_count * 1.0) FROM per_nat) AS diff_from_avg FROM per_nat

WITH cat AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description AS d, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_diff FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.avg_qty) AS avg_of_avg_quantity, AVG(cat.avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_cost_diff, AVG(cat.avg_diff - m.mean_diff) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM cat CROSS JOIN m WHERE cat.avg_diff > m.mean_diff

WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS zoneref, st.riskeval AS riskeval, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval), t AS (SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressratio, scan_count, scan_count * 1.0 / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), r AS (SELECT t.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) AS rnk FROM t) SELECT zoneref, riskeval, avg_pressratio, scan_count, share FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share DESC

WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS baseline FROM t), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price, base.baseline FROM t CROSS JOIN base WHERE base.baseline IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_price > base.baseline), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS kept_mean FROM kept), fin AS (SELECT k.avg_price, k.baseline, km.kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN km WHERE k.avg_price > km.kept_mean) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(avg_price - baseline) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(avg_price - kept_mean) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM fin

WITH c AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), r AS (SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS rnk FROM c) SELECT telescref, signal_count, fraction FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, telescref
