WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM g), b AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline FROM s) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt AS behaviour_record_count, share, share - baseline AS share_above_baseline FROM b WHERE share > baseline ORDER BY share DESC

WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

WITH t AS (SELECT ID, HGB*1.0/HCT AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0), p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(r) AS ratio FROM t GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS a FROM p), k AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.a AS d1 FROM p, o WHERE p.ratio > o.a), s AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS a2 FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.ratio, k.d1, k.ratio - s.a2 AS d2 FROM k, s WHERE k.ratio > s.a2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_second FROM f

WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_abs_diff FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_abs_diff) AS overall_avg FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_abs_diff, g.avg_abs_diff - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL

WITH m AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS z, s.entrystat AS e, f.facetfaces AS ff FROM scanmesh f JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = f.zoneref), base AS (SELECT AVG(ff) AS b FROM m), site AS (SELECT z, e, AVG(ff) AS a FROM m GROUP BY z, e HAVING AVG(ff) IS NOT NULL), st AS (SELECT e, AVG(a) AS sa FROM site WHERE e IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e), kept AS (SELECT site.a AS a, base.b AS b, st.sa AS sa FROM site JOIN st ON site.e = st.e CROSS JOIN base WHERE site.a > st.sa AND base.b IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_kept_site_avg, AVG(a - b) AS avg_excess_over_baseline, AVG(a - sa) AS avg_excess_over_status_avg FROM kept

WITH per_name AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_name) SELECT AVG(p.avg_points) AS avg_of_avg_points, AVG(p.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(p.cnt - o.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM per_name p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.cnt > o.avg_cnt

WITH pairs AS (SELECT a.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM pairs), scored AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_type_avg FROM scored WHERE share >= avg_share GROUP BY tradekind

WITH c AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state),''),'') AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_college pc JOIN college co ON co.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY pc.college_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(co.state),''),'')) SELECT state, AVG(cnt*1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(cnt*1.0/(SELECT AVG(cnt*1.0) FROM c)) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_avg, AVG(cnt*1.0/(SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c)) AS avg_share_of_total FROM c GROUP BY state

WITH rc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp p JOIN account a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), sh AS (SELECT region, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM rc), av AS (SELECT region, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM av WHERE share > avg_share;

WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country,'')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_group_avgs FROM g

WITH j AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS t FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark), c AS (SELECT t, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY t), s AS (SELECT t, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT t, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_anly FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind HAVING AVG(s.anlycount) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anly) AS mean_avg FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.avg_anly, p.avg_anly - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_anly > o.mean_avg), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_anly) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_excess_over_mean, avg_analyst_count / AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER () AS relative_ratio FROM per_type ORDER BY tradekind

WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts), above AS (SELECT rc.film_count, o.avg_count FROM rating_counts rc CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rc.film_count > o.avg_count) SELECT AVG(film_count) AS avg_count_above, AVG(film_count - avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM above

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost,
         SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(i.avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
       AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(i.ratio) - o.avg_ratio AS ratio_excess_over_overall_avg
FROM inv i
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio
GROUP BY o.avg_ratio;

WITH g AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_rate FROM g WHERE bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg_rate DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per_actor AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM per_actor ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_relative_gap, g.avg_rebate - b.baseline AS excess_over_baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_rebate > b.baseline ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH r AS (SELECT ra.circuitId, c.country, ra.round FROM races ra JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId), cc AS (SELECT circuitId, country, AVG(round) AS avg_round FROM r GROUP BY circuitId, country), ct AS (SELECT country, AVG(round) AS country_avg FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.avg_round, cc.avg_round - ct.country_avg AS diff FROM cc JOIN ct ON ct.country = cc.country ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10

WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS overall FROM per), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h, o.overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN ov o WHERE p.avg_h > o.overall), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS kept_mean FROM kept), r AS (SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_h AS avg_humidity, k.avg_h - k.overall AS excess_over_overall, k.avg_h - m.kept_mean AS diff_from_kept_mean, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY k.avg_h - m.kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST) AS rnk FROM kept k CROSS JOIN km m WHERE m.kept_mean IS NOT NULL AND k.overall IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall, diff_from_kept_mean FROM r WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST, equipref

WITH r AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, CAST(v.points_won AS REAL)/v.points_max AS ratio FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM c) AS ratio_to_mean_of_country_avgs FROM c

WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, u.acctscope AS acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg WHERE avg_feerate IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate, p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg), ranked AS (SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC) AS rnk FROM kept) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rnk FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, rnk
